edits.new: The manifest of the load — the workbook reference, the generated DRL, the SHA-256, the valid-from date, the test result and the dry-run counts — is stored on the version row. The registry accepts two package formats on one runtime, an XLS decision table and an OMG DMN 1.6 model (GAP-1620; ADR-017): a package version names its format, the load checks and the model fetch keep both formats, and a conversion from one format to the other is a version change with its own test evidence.
